cohort: 995 women aged 13-46 years who delivered at Lucrécia Paím Maternity in Luanda, Angola between December 2012 and February 2013
finding: Early and adequate prenatal care is crucial for improved pregnancy outcomes, as evidenced by its association with favorable birth weight and gestational age at delivery in Angolan women.
mod_finding: Increased prenatal visits were associated with a higher likelihood of cesarean delivery in both primiparous and multiparous women.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was defined as birth weight < 2500g
